CD.CDComment:
Content Dictionary for the K'UHUL Fold Graph semantic contract. Defines FoldPair and its structural constraints as formalised in vectors.mml and fold_graph.xml.
Key invariant (no-pattern-inflation): |supp M[Y,·]| = #{X ∈ S : Y ∈ C_X} FoldPair increases operator surface; it does not increase |X|.
Notation: M_{Y,X} = co-occurrence/association mass (forward matrix). Do not conflate with W_Y = runtime selection weight (static_weight in WCR). M and W are distinct; they feed different pipeline stages.

CDDefinition.Name: FoldPair
CDDefinition.Description:
FoldPair(S) = ⟨ M_{Y,X}, C_{Y,X}^T ⟩
Returns a logical pair of accumulation matrices over the shared semantic axis X ∈ S. The pair is a semantic contract, not a physical memory layout.
Arguments: S — semantic position set (the X axis; fixed by the topology map)
Result members: M_{Y,X} — forward (membership) co-occurrence mass matrix: M[Y][X] += 1 if Y ∈ C_X, else 0. NOT the WCR runtime selection weight W_Y (static_weight). C_{Y,X}^T — reverse (traversal) matrix, transposed: C[Y][X] += 1 for each Y ∈ C_X
Shared axis: X (both members indexed over the same S)
Physical lowering to [ M ; C^T ] is optional and backend-chosen. This symbol asserts only the logical pair.

property.description: FoldPair does not lower to a concatenated matrix. Physical backends may choose [M; C^T] but this symbol does not assert it.
Direction asymmetry is intentional: M uses membership test (indicator); C uses traversal (double quantifier). Both are correct update rules for the same underlying data.

CDDefinition.Name: FoldPairLower
CDDefinition.Description:
FoldPairLower( FoldPair(S) ) = [ M ; C^T ]
Optional physical lowering of a FoldPair to a contiguous stacked matrix. May only be applied when the physical backend requires vertical concatenation. Storage dimensions: (2·|Y|) × |X|.
This symbol is non-normative with respect to the semantic contract. The semantic contract is FoldPair; FoldPairLower is a projection.

property.description: semantic contract ≠ physical representation (fold_graph.xml law: representation-is-provider)

CDDefinition.Name: Axis
CDDefinition.Description:
Axis(name, set) declares a named semantic axis indexed over a set. Used to assert that two matrices share a coordinate system without implying physical adjacency.
Example: Axis("X", S) declares that both M_{Y,X} and C_{Y,X} are indexed by the same position set S.

CDDefinition.Name: supp
CDDefinition.Description: supp(v) — support of a vector v: the set of indices at which v is nonzero. Used in the no-pattern-inflation property of FoldPair: |supp M[Y,·]| = #{X ∈ S : Y ∈ C_X}.

CDDefinition.Name: setbuilder
CDDefinition.Description: setbuilder(x, domain_condition, filter_condition) — set-builder notation: { x | domain_condition AND filter_condition }. Used to express #{X ∈ S : Y ∈ C_X} in the shared-axis constraint.
